title: erdos-harness: research record and Lean 4 formalization for Erdős Problem 872
description:
Research record and Lean 4 formalization for the resolution of Erdős Problem 872: in the game where two players alternately select integers from {2,...,n} that must remain an antichain under divisibility — Prolonger maximizing the number of moves, Shortener minimizing it — the guaranteed game length satisfies L(n) = o(n).

This archive contains the full manuscript, 179 rounds of research dispatches, audits, and refutations, and the Lean 4 project (erdos-872/lean/r177_verification) in which the theorem Erdos872.main is kernel-checked for the original game from exactly one problem-specific axiom, A3_exceptional_set_estimate (Lemma 2.3 of the manuscript, an exceptional-set density estimate proved there by the Selberg sieve and Rankin's method but not yet formalized). Axiom report: propext, Classical.choice, A3_exceptional_set_estimate, Quot.sound.

Produced by an AI research system (GPT-5-class primary researchers, Claude as curator and researcher, independent Lean kernel check), directed by the author. Code is MIT-licensed; research artifacts are CC-BY 4.0.
